panels.title: Big questions
points: How are breathing, gas exchange and respiration linked, and how are they different?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'Do not throw yourselves with your own hands into destruction' (al-Baqarah 2:195). Knowing how smoking damages the gas exchange system helps us protect the trust of our bodies.

keywords.def: releases energy from glucose using oxygen

air sacs adapted for gas exchange
molecule that provides energy for cells

panels.title: Revision: respiration and human gas exchange
points: Plants and yeast anaerobic: glucose → ethanol + CO₂

panels.title: Explain why boiled seeds are used in the respiring seeds experiment. [2 marks]
points: Boiled seeds are dead and do not respire
They act as a control to show any temperature rise is due to respiration
Answer: Control; dead seeds do not respire
